usedFor: TidyCal holds bookings, and Dropbox saves a file when “When a booking is rescheduled” runs “Upload File to Dropbox”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a booking is rescheduled” in TidyCal, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: A rescheduled booking can save an updated prep document into a Dropbox folder.

watchOut: TidyCal triggers are polling, so the upload follows a scheduled check.
